name: Essence of the Exile

angles.text: Alchemical cauldrons and elemental transmutations can bind separate essences into solid form through volatile magic.
Even when bubbling cauldrons churn molten rock, working with elemental essences calls for understanding the primal forces at play.

aliases: what is essence of the exile
faq.answer: Essence of the Exile is a transmutation ritual performed at a bubbling cauldron. Charms set off a violent reaction that yields a churning lump of molten rock.
faq.q: What is the Essence of the Exile?

faq.answer: The cauldron's vapors draw travelers close. Charms sink to the bottom, then a large bubble bursts at the surface and leaves molten stone behind.
faq.q: What happens when charms are placed in the cauldron?

aliases: what is produced from the cauldron
what do you get from essence of the exile
faq.answer: When a large bubble bursts at the surface, a churning lump of molten rock is revealed inside the cauldron.

aliases: where do i find the cauldron
faq.answer: The ritual takes place at a boiling cauldron whose hot vapors beckon travelers. There, the vessel transforms its contents.
faq.q: Where is the cauldron used for this ritual?

aliases: why do charms go in the cauldron
faq.answer: The charms are consumed as reagents in the cauldron's depths. Their presence in the heated liquid helps form the molten rock.
faq.q: Why are charms placed into the cauldron?

faq.answer: The bubbling liquid and beckoning vapors mark an active reaction within the vessel. It is ready to transform whatever enters its depths.
faq.q: Why is the cauldron constantly bubbling?

sections.body: A bubbling cauldron sends out vapors that draw travelers to its churning depths. Specific enchanted charms stir an intense reaction within the vessel.
sections.title: A Beckoning Cauldron

sections.body: The charms sink slowly through the liquid. Then a large bubble rises and bursts, revealing a churning lump of molten rock forged from the combined materials.
sections.title: The Molten Crucible

summary: At the cauldron, Essence of the Exile draws travelers with its beckoning vapors. Charms set off a violent reaction that reveals molten rock.
attribution: In-game quest text: Essence of the Exile
